# caption

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:caption`](gmeow-caption.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/caption>

A caption for a media object — the short text shown with an image, audio, or video ([schema:caption](https://schema.org/caption)). Non-functional.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for the short descriptive text displayed alongside an image, audio, or video; non-functional, so localized captions coexist.

### Avoid when

- Avoid it for the full verbatim transcript of audio/video (use [`gmeow:transcript`](gmeow-transcript.md)) and avoid it for the work's title (use [`gmeow:hasTitle`](gmeow-hasTitle.md) / [`gmeow:title`](gmeow-title.md)).

### How to use

- Attach the caption literal on [`gmeow:caption`](gmeow-caption.md) with a language tag; it projects to [schema:caption.](https://schema.org/caption.) Use [`gmeow:transcript`](gmeow-transcript.md) for the full audio text.

### Examples

- ex:photo [`gmeow:caption`](gmeow-caption.md) "Sunset over the harbour, 2019."@en.
